c:capability.name: ZWaveDirectAssociation
c:capability.c:description: Manages Z-Wave direct device-to-device associations. Allows configuring which devices a Z-Wave node will directly control without hub intervention (e.g., a button remote directly dimming a light via Association Group).

c:attribute.name: maxGroups
c:attribute.description: Number of association groups supported by the device.

c:attribute.name: associations
c:attribute.description: JSON map of group to node list, e.g. {"2": [5, 7], "3": [5]}.

c:method.name: SetAssociation
c:method.description: Add a node to an association group.

c:method.name: RemoveAssociation
c:method.description: Remove a node from an association group.

c:method.name: GetAssociation
c:method.description: Query the members of an association group.

c:method.name: GetSupportedGroups
c:method.description: Query the number of association groups supported.

c:method.name: ClearAssociation
c:method.description: Remove all nodes from an association group.
